title: Grass fires spark along I-80 in Salt Lake County
text:
Two grass fires have ignited along I-80 in Salt Lake County, burning near 5600 West and 7200 West.
Fire crews battled a grass fire that started along I-80 near 5600 West on Wednesday. Two grass fires have ignited along I-80 in Salt Lake County.
According to the Salt Lake City Fire Department, multiple crews gathered to tackle one blaze located near 5600 West and 200 South in Salt Lake City. The Salt Lake City Fire Department said the fire near 5600 West started near I-80 and burned approximately five acres. Crews were "mopping up" around 9:43 p.m. The remaining danger comes from two power poles that were burned through and are at risk of falling, according to fire crews.
The nearby Maverick gas station on 300 South was evacuated as a precaution. The fire department announced power outages due to burnt power poles between 400 South and 300 North along the 5600 West corridor near I-80. Rocky Mountain Power crews plan to oversee repairs throughout the night. Approximately 15 firefighters gathered at the scene of another fire on I-80, this one near 7200 West.
The Salt Lake City Fire Department estimates the second blaze is approximately 5 acres in size. A Utah Fire Authority firefighter sprays water on a grass fire near I-80 and 7200 West on Wednesday, July 8, 2026. This story will be updated.
